1966281507.inGameDescription: Blocking damage partially reloads this weapon from reserves.

1967250736.name: Command Frame II
1967250736.inGameDescription: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles at a reduced rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage when aiming down sights.

1967250737.name: Command Frame III
1967250737.inGameDescription: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles at a reduced rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage when aiming down sights.

1967250742.name: Command Frame IV
1967250742.inGameDescription: Fires extended-range, heavy-caliber projectiles at a reduced rate of fire. Deals increased precision damage when aiming down sights.

1968098204.name: Ricochet Rounds
1968098204.inGameDescription:
Rounds ricochet off hard surfaces. 
  •  Increases stability 
  •  Slightly increases range

1968497646.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
1968497646.inGameDescription:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

1969105489.name: Hammer of the Gods
1969105489.inGameDescription: Defeating targets with your Thunderclap melee restores melee energy. Targets near you when you use your Thunderclap suffer lightning strikes and become jolted; being amplified increases the damage of these lightning strikes.

1971489086.name: The Fourth Magic
1971489086.inGameDescription: Weapon final blows with a damage type matching your grenade grant Death Throes, which provide a grenade damage bonus and grant you grenade energy. When you have Death Throes and throw a grenade, nearby allies gain greatly increased grenade regeneration for a short time.

1978306813.name: Wave Sword Frame
1978306813.inGameDescription:
Heavy attack deploys a shockwave uppercut and launches the user into the air.
An immediate follow-up swing after the uppercut deploys a homing strike that aggressively seeks a target.

1980732122.name: Blades of Unmaking
1980732122.inGameDescription: [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_melee_uncharged_button###] [###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_melee_uncharged_verb###] : Perform a melee attack using this weapon's frontal blades. Capable of performing a swift two-hit combo.

1980796560.name: Shield Throw
1980796560.inGameDescription: Hurl your Void Shield toward a target. The shield can ricochet off targets and surfaces, granting Overshield for each target hit.

1980796561.name: Shiver Strike
1980796561.inGameDescription: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.

1980796562.name: Hammer Strike
1980796562.inGameDescription:
After sprinting for a short time, use this melee ability to swing a blazing hammer that scorches your target and deals damage in a cone behind them.

If your target is defeated by Hammer Strike, they ignite.

1980796563.name: Thunderclap
1980796563.inGameDescription:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.

1980796564.name: Frenzied Blade
1980796564.inGameDescription: Activate your charged melee ability to dash forward, slashing at targets in front of you and severing them.

1986105578.name: Aggressive Glaive
1986105578.inGameDescription: Hard-hitting, slow melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield. Generates shield energy on dealing ranged damage.

1987021001.name: Rifled Barrel
1987021001.inGameDescription:
Ranged shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases range
  •  Greatly decreases handling speed

1988485648.name: Dealer's Choice
1988485648.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant a small amount of Super energy. Equipping multiple weapons from the Pale Heart increases this effect.

1992361643.name: Anti-Taken Fletching
1992361643.inGameDescription:
Specialized to fight Taken targets.
  •  Increases accuracy

1992365846.name: Loyal Moths
1992365846.inGameDescription: Final blows and rapid direct hits with this weapon create a loyal moth. The moth will seek out nearby targets and detonate, damaging and blinding them.

1996142143.name: Black Powder
1996142143.inGameDescription:
This weapon's explosives are more effective.
  •  Slightly increases blast radius
  •  Decreases stability

1998010051.name: Malevolent Grasp
1998010051.inGameDescription: While a Strand Super is equipped, casting Rift will suspend nearby combatants. Suspend deals damage over time, which heals you in the process. Targets who break free from suspension suffer additional damage. Defeating suspended targets heals you a moderate amount.

2000295559.name: Turnabout
2000295559.inGameDescription: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield for an improved duration.

2000464223.name: Hail Storm
2000464223.inGameDescription: Direct hits with Stasis arrows freeze combatants and slow opposing Guardians. Stasis arrows that impact the environment create Stasis crystals.

2002547233.name: High-Impact Reserves
2002547233.inGameDescription: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage. Improved damage starts earlier in the magazine.

2003022817.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2003022817.inGameDescription: Fires full auto with deeper ammo reserves. Faster reload when weapon is empty.

2003108620.name: Thin the Herd
2003108620.inGameDescription: Direct hits do increased damage to combatant shields and cause a volatile detonation. Dealing damage increases reload speed. Rapid final blows against grenade-damaged combatants refill the magazine.

2005566727.name: Nucleosynthetic Magazine
2005566727.inGameDescription: This magazine continuously draws ammo from reserves. The magazine also enables firing Arc projectiles that detonate on impact.

2010801679.name: Ambitious Assassin
2010801679.inGameDescription: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

2012023082.name: Area Denial Frame
2012023082.inGameDescription: Burst fire Grenade Launcher. Each projectile creates a lingering pool on impact that deals damage over time.

2012402531.name: Extrovert
2012402531.inGameDescription: Final blows while near multiple combatants or near Nightmares restores an improved amount of health.

2012877834.name: Lightweight Frame
2012877834.inGameDescription:
Recurve Bow. Draw quickly and move faster while this weapon is equipped. 
[Reload]  : Use while drawn to cancel the shot.

2014892510.name: Perpetual Motion
2014892510.inGameDescription: This weapon gains bonus stability, handling, and reload speed while the wielder is in motion for a short duration.

2018366981.name: Lodestar Catalyst
2018366981.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2019952880.name: Serve the Colony
2019952880.inGameDescription: Insectoid robot grenades quickly repopulate the magazine from reserves while the Colony is unequipped.

2021620139.name: Glacial Quake
2021620139.inGameDescription:
Summon a [Stasis] Stasis gauntlet. While your Super is active:

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam your gauntlet down to create a shockwave that freezes targets and sends out [Stasis] Stasis crystals to freeze additional ones.

[Light Attack]  : Supercharge your Shiver Strike for bonus damage. Sprint through [Stasis] Stasis crystals or frozen targets to shatter them instantly.

2024652627.name: Property: Irreducible
2024652627.inGameDescription: [Alternate Weapon Action] : Consume your grenade to load a large [projectile|shape|language] that generates an elemental explosion on impact and deals increased damage while Transcendence is active.

2028772231.name: Shiver Strike
2028772231.inGameDescription: Hold input to leap through the air. Releasing unleashes a powerful dash attack that knocks targets back and attaches a delayed Stasis explosive to them.

2030760728.name: Energy Transfer
2030760728.inGameDescription: Guarding while receiving damage generates class ability energy.

2034764268.name: Forge's Kin
2034764268.inGameDescription: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant significantly more ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration significantly increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.

2037312142.name: Controlled Burst
2037312142.inGameDescription: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for an improved duration.

2037533514.name: Enhanced Resistant Tether
2037533514.inGameDescription: Active only in the "Garden of Salvation" raid.

2038196759.name: Edge of Intent Catalyst
2038196759.inGameDescription: Reloading shortly after dealing a final blow grants Cure to you and your nearby allies.

2039302152.name: Slideways
2039302152.inGameDescription: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability.

2039482529.name: Cooling Baubles
2039482529.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup, collecting an Orb of Power, or destroying a Tangle reduces slightly more heat.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

2040155611.name: Aggressive Glaive
2040155611.inGameDescription: Hard-hitting, slow melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield. Generates shield energy on dealing ranged damage.

2041432007.name: Dark Ether Reaper
2041432007.inGameDescription:
Final blows with this weapon periodically spawn Dark Ether charges.

Charges can be detonated early with weapons fire or by coming into contact with them. Doing so refills this weapon from reserves.

2048641572.name: Destabilizing Rounds
2048641572.inGameDescription: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

2052299741.name: Countermass
2052299741.inGameDescription:
This weapon is weighted for vertical recoil.
  •  Greatly controls recoil
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

2053642371.name: Unsated Hunger
2053642371.inGameDescription:
Increased handling, reload speed, and stability when no abilities are fully charged.

Swords gain increased guard resistance and charge rate instead.

2054312700.name: SC Holo
2054312700.inGameDescription:
Häkke holo sights. Medium zoom. 
  •  Greatly increases range 
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

2054312701.name: SD Thermal
2054312701.inGameDescription:
Häkke thermal imaging scope. Medium-zoom. Highlights enemy targets. 
  •  Increases range

2054520291.name: Lucky Shot
2054520291.inGameDescription: Reloading after a precision final blow causes precision hits to refill a round from reserves.

2057080438.name: Meaning-Making
2057080438.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon create a Threadling nest that periodically spawns Threadlings. Final blows with this weapon near an existing Threadling nest create a Threadling instead.

2057203855.name: Precision Frame
2057203855.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2073244114.name: Lone Wolf
2073244114.inGameDescription: Improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

2073750249.name: Light Battery
2073750249.inGameDescription:
Lightweight, agile battery.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases reload speed

2074494595.name: Will of Light (Stasis)
2074494595.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "King's Fall" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2077819806.name: Eager Edge
2077819806.inGameDescription: Gain increased Sword lunge distance immediately after switching to this weapon.

2078075300.name: Support Frame
2078075300.inGameDescription: Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and grants Amplified to your allies.

2078097559.name: Polymer Grip
2078097559.inGameDescription:
This weapon's grip is made of lighter material.
  •  Increases handling speed

2078520142.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
2078520142.inGameDescription: Rapid final blows spawn a larger Stasis crystal near the victim's location.

2085058762.name: D.A.R.C.I. Catalyst
2085058762.inGameDescription: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2085058763.name: Borealis Catalyst
2085058763.inGameDescription: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2085665100.name: Head Rush
2085665100.inGameDescription: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of improved bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.

2087010644.name: Rally Barricade
2087010644.inGameDescription: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2087010645.name: Towering Barricade
2087010645.inGameDescription: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2091001077.name: Cluster Bomb
2091001077.inGameDescription: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation. Blast radius is increased.

2094305299.name: Precision Frame
2094305299.inGameDescription:
Fires a slower grenade projectile that bounces. 
[Shoot]  : Fire; release to detonate.

2094761202.name: Grand Overture Catalyst
2094761202.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2094939076.name: Charged with Blight
2094939076.inGameDescription: Precision hits increase stability and reload speed and drain combatants' life force to charge a ball of Darkness. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to restore health and fire the charged projectile, shrouding combatants in Darkness to temporarily blind them and inflict corruption.

2100231191.name: Micro-Missile Frame
2100231191.inGameDescription: Fires self-propelled micro-missiles that explode on impact for high damage.

2105054824.name: Lightweight Frame
2105054824.inGameDescription:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy dash attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

2108556049.name: Lightweight Frame
2108556049.inGameDescription:
Recurve Bow. Draw quickly and move faster while this weapon is equipped. 
[Reload]  : Use while drawn to cancel the shot.

2108812838.name: High-Velocity Rounds
2108812838.inGameDescription:
This weapon's projectiles are particularly light and quick.
  •  Increases projectile speed
  •  Increases reload speed

2109543898.name: Desperate Measures
2109543898.inGameDescription: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

2113691818.name: Xenophage Catalyst
2113691818.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2117683199.name: Full Auto Trigger System
2117683199.inGameDescription: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto.

2119325971.name: Vanishing Shadow
2119325971.inGameDescription: Increases the duration of any invisibility effects. When you gain invisibility, your grenade, melee and class abilities recharge faster. At maximum stacks, you gain a Void Overshield as well.

2120661319.name: Field-Tested
2120661319.inGameDescription:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

2121086290.name: Rat Pack
2121086290.inGameDescription: This fully automatic weapon becomes stronger when nearby allies also have it equipped. Stacks up to 6 times.

2125798995.name: +Health / -Weapons
2125798995.inGameDescription: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Weapons stat.

2126519017.name: Enhanced Heatsink
2126519017.inGameDescription: Strong battery life. Reduces heat generation.

2130042297.name: Taken Predator
2130042297.inGameDescription: Bonus damage against Taken enemies and Gambit invaders.

2133978453.name: Light Touch
2133978453.inGameDescription: This weapon gains increased reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

2135276011.name: Eyes Up, Guardian
2135276011.inGameDescription: Collecting Orbs of Power strengthens this weapon's next several ricochet shots, providing more damage and more bounces between targets.

2136073194.name: Spring-Auger Bolts
2136073194.inGameDescription:
Bolts release an impulse shortly after impact that deals a small amount of damage and has a high chance to cause flinch.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

2138673996.name: Ancillary Ordinance
2138673996.inGameDescription: Rapid elemental final blows and final blows on targets affected by elemental debuffs periodically prepare a homing micro-missile, which is launched from your target after this weapon's next final blow. More missiles can be prepared.

2139363611.name: Well-Rounded
2139363611.inGameDescription:
Throwing a grenade or hitting a target with a charged melee grants an improved stacking bonus to weapon stability, handling, and range.

Using a Super grants maximum stacks.

2140591236.name: High Ground
2140591236.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks. Increases reload.

2142852459.name: Herd Thinner
2142852459.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Deep Stone Crypt" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2144092201.name: Noble Rounds
2144092201.inGameDescription: Kills with this weapon leave behind Remnants. Absorbing a Remnant converts your next hipfired shot into an ally-seeking Noble Round and partially refills the magazine.

2144580852.name: Tri-Planar Mass Driver
2144580852.inGameDescription: Fires a spread of Void energy projectiles. Aiming down sights narrows the spread.

2145198832.name: No Time to Explain Catalyst
2145198832.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2152442764.name: Nail, Meet Hammer
2152442764.inGameDescription: This weapon is more effective against combatant shields. Destroying a shield with this weapon grants bonus Special ammo progress if it uses Primary or Heavy ammo, or Heavy ammo progress if it uses Special ammo.

2154191829.name: Carbon Arrow Shaft
2154191829.inGameDescription:
Light and stable shaft material. 
  •  Increases stability

2154730217.name: Ballistic Tuning
2154730217.inGameDescription:
Power diverted from shield.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases shield duration

2155015844.name: Legacy PR-55 Frame
2155015844.inGameDescription: Customized frame with dramatically increased accuracy, stability, and targeting while hip firing.

2158846614.name: Tangled Up
2158846614.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Root of Nightmares" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod will not improve its effects.

2159352803.name: Aggressive Frame
2159352803.inGameDescription: High damage, high recoil. Optimized for long-distance shooting.

2164888232.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2164888232.inGameDescription: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

2167115920.name: Balanced Heat Weapon
2167115920.inGameDescription: Increased damage versus powerful combatants. Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.

2167611941.name: Reverberation
2167611941.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon increase the size of its detonations for an improved duration.

2170254329.name: Heavy Burst
2170254329.inGameDescription: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

2171055345.name: Psychohack
2171055345.inGameDescription:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for a short duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

2171805903.name: Perpetual Loophole
2171805903.inGameDescription: Deal additional melee damage while protected by an overshield. Defeating targets with melee final blows while the overshield is active will refresh it.

2172195298.name: Armor-Piercing Rounds
2172195298.inGameDescription:
Rounds cause extra damage to combatants' shields and overpenetrate targets. 
  •  Slightly increases range

2172504645.name: Sleight of Hand
2172504645.inGameDescription: Final blows with weapons or abilities while this weapon is stowed increase its handling, stability, and reload speed for a short duration.

2173046394.name: Voltshot
2173046394.inGameDescription: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target overcharges this weapon for a short period of time, causing it to jolt on its next hit.

2174503023.name: Arc Alignment
2174503023.inGameDescription: Dealing Arc damage from any source aligns the battery's coils. When alignment is complete, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to disengage the safety and enable hip-fired Starlight Beam to apply Jolt to any targets damaged for a short time.  Aim down sights to slow the rate at which the battery drains.

2178772051.name: Adaptive Frame
2178772051.inGameDescription: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.

2179827240.name: Roast 'Em
2179827240.inGameDescription:
Your Proximity Knife scorches targets it damages with its explosions, or ignites targets on final blow.

After throwing a Proximity Knife, you gain increased melee regeneration until the knife explodes. Gain a small amount of melee energy when your Scorch damages a target, and Ignition final blows fully refund melee energy and can overflow into an additional knife charge.

2179914730.name: Banshee's Wail
2179914730.inGameDescription:
[Block]  : Hold to rev the blade.
 • Increases damage and adds [Shield-Piercing] shield piercing to all attacks.
 • Gain stacks when dealing damage with revved attacks.
 • Additional stacks increase the damage and damage resistance of heavy attacks.

2181638943.name: Heavy Bolts
2181638943.inGameDescription:
Bolts deal increased damage, but are slower and more affected by gravity.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

2186532310.name: Poison Arrows
2186532310.inGameDescription: Arrows fired while perfectly drawn become poison arrows. Precision hits with poison arrows stun the combatant and spread poison to nearby ones. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

2189829540.name: Adaptive Frame
2189829540.inGameDescription: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.

2192678014.name: Roving Assassin
2192678014.inGameDescription:
Each Spectral Blades hit or final blow you make before becoming invisible will restore more of your Super energy.

Exiting invisibility while near a target creates a cloud of weakening smoke around you.

2192678015.name: Double Dodge
2192678015.inGameDescription: Gain a second dodge charge. Shortly after dodging, your next weapon final blow spawns an Orb of Power.

2193118393.name: Longview SLR10
2193118393.inGameDescription:
Balanced scope. Medium zoom. 
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

2193118396.name: Ambush SLH25
2193118396.inGameDescription:
Agile, snappy scope. Short zoom.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases range

2193118397.name: EagleEye SLR20
2193118397.inGameDescription:
Powerful scope. Long zoom. 
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed

2193118398.name: Shortgaze SLH10
2193118398.inGameDescription:
Thin-lens scope. Short zoom. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

2193118399.name: Longview SLR20
2193118399.inGameDescription:
Strong optics. Long zoom.
  •  Increases range

2199828458.name: Buried Bloodline Catalyst
2199828458.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2200569208.name: Eyes on All
2200569208.inGameDescription: This weapon is capable of tracking and firing at multiple targets simultaneously.

2202441959.name: Firebolt Grenade
2202441959.inGameDescription: A grenade that unleashes bolts of damaging Solar Light at nearby targets and slightly scorches them.

2204713148.name: Crystalline Transistor
2204713148.inGameDescription:
Final blows from Kinetic weapons create an explosion in the element of your equipped Super that deals damage and applies a matching elemental effect:
• [Arc] Blinds targets.
• [Solar] Scorches targets.
• [Void] Weakens targets.
• [Stasis] Slows targets.
• [Strand] Severs targets.
Elemental final blows temporarily increase the explosion's size. Precision final blows always maximum the explosion's size.

2204713149.name: Battle-Hearth
2204713149.inGameDescription: Kills and assists you make while standing in your Well of Radiance return Super energy.

2206869417.name: Häkke Heavy Burst Fire
2206869417.inGameDescription: Fires a less stable burst of two high-damage, high-range rounds.

2209081648.name: Empowering Rift
2209081648.inGameDescription:
Conjure a well of power that increases weapon damage and ability energy regeneration for those inside it.

Defeating combatants while standing in the Rift grants additional ammo generation.

2209081649.name: Healing Rift
2209081649.inGameDescription: Conjure a well of power that continuously heals those inside it.

2209280306.name: IS 5 Circle
2209280306.inGameDescription:
Circular iron sights. Short zoom. 
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

2209280307.name: IS 2 Classic
2209280307.inGameDescription:
Rugged and simple iron sights. Short zoom. 
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases range

2209918983.name: Turnabout
2209918983.inGameDescription: Using this weapon to break the shield of a combatant or a Guardian using their Super will grant you an overshield.

2213355989.name: High-Impact Reserves
2213355989.inGameDescription: Rounds at the end of the magazine deal more damage.

2213377102.name: MIDA Synergy
2213377102.inGameDescription: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped. When MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped, this weapon grants additional speed benefits and final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.

2213429699.name: Heavy Burst
2213429699.inGameDescription: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

2216471363.name: Disruption Break
2216471363.inGameDescription: Breaking a combatant's shield with this weapon makes them more vulnerable to Kinetic damage for an improved duration.

2216535938.name: Butterfly
2216535938.inGameDescription: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing causes your target to explode the next time you deal final blows. Timer resets when you stop aiming down sights.

2216698406.name: Solar Grenade
2216698406.inGameDescription: A grenade that creates a flare of Solar Light that continuously damages and scorches targets trapped inside.

2217963031.name: Shot Swap
2217963031.inGameDescription: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at an additionally improved rate.

2223032959.name: Ruinscribe's Beacon
2223032959.inGameDescription: While a Ruinscribe Turret is deployed, this weapon can paint targets with its laser projectiles. The turret prioritizes painted targets and fires more powerful munitions at them. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to swap between normal fire and laser fire modes.

2223800157.name: Problem Solver
2223800157.inGameDescription:
Dealing sustained damage to Champion, miniboss, or boss combatants exhausts them and grants this weapon handling and reload speed for a longer duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

2223914385.name: Thunderer
2223914385.inGameDescription: This weapon's rate of fire is increased significantly, and fires full auto. Final blows auto load ammo from reserves. Powerful targets fully reload the weapon.

2224838837.name: Unstoppable Force
2224838837.inGameDescription: Blocking damage with your shield increases projectile damage for a short time.

2225231092.name: High Lift
2225231092.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air to greater heights.

2225231093.name: Strafe Lift
2225231093.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with strong directional control.

2225231094.name: Catapult Lift
2225231094.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Lift and launch into the air with a strong initial burst of momentum.

2226793914.name: Guidance Ring
2226793914.inGameDescription: Precision hits and final blows build Guidance Ring energy. Opposing Guardians grant additional energy. At full charge, hip firing creates a Guidance Ring.

2234507197.name: Collective Obligation Catalyst
2234507197.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2235383762.name: Support Frame
2235383762.inGameDescription: Capable of healing allies and hurting foes. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and grants Overshield to your allies.

2238035098.name: Storm and Stress
2238035098.inGameDescription: Final blows with Together Forever weapons reload this weapon and overflow bonus damage rounds into the magazine. Final blows with bonus damage rounds increase the magazine capacity of Together Forever weapons.

2241043034.name: Close to Melee
2241043034.inGameDescription: Glaive projectile final blows improve Glaive melee damage for an improved duration. Glaive projectile or melee damage extends the duration.

2244422610.name: +Super / -Weapons
2244422610.inGameDescription: Increases this armor's Tuned stat at the cost of a small amount of the Weapons stat.

2244851822.name: Flash Counter
2244851822.inGameDescription: Blocking damage after raising your guard emits a short-range blast that disorients targets.

2250679103.name: Search Party
2250679103.inGameDescription: This weapon is granted faster aim down sights speed and movement speed while aiming down sights when no allies are near.

2260261934.name: Mega Kill Clip
2260261934.inGameDescription: Reloading after a final blow grants a longer period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

2260949877.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2260949877.inGameDescription: Fires full auto with deeper ammo reserves. Faster reload when weapon is empty.

2263539715.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2263539715.inGameDescription: Fires full auto with deeper ammo reserves. Faster reload when weapon is empty.

2264456959.name: Compressed Wave Frame
2264456959.inGameDescription: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.

2265076177.name: Suppressor Grenade
2265076177.inGameDescription: An explosive grenade that suppresses, preventing targets from using abilities for a short time.

2271572658.name: Lumina Catalyst
2271572658.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain an additional perk.

Heal allies with Noble Rounds to unlock this upgrade.

2272927194.name: Perfect Float
2272927194.inGameDescription: Being in combat for a moderate time increases airborne effectiveness and reduces flinch until you are out of combat.

2274196884.name: Song of Flame
2274196884.inGameDescription:
Unleash your inner fire, making your equipped weapons radiant and enhancing your abilities.

[Melee]  : Release a supercharged melee attack that launches additional projectiles.

[Grenade]  : Create a sentient flame wisp that seeks out targets and detonates in a scorching explosion, then seeks out other nearby targets.

While Song of Flame is active, you and nearby allies regenerate abilities more quickly, are more resistant to incoming damage, and your [Solar] Solar and Kinetic weapons scorch targets.

2274196886.name: Daybreak
2274196886.inGameDescription:
Fashion Solar Light into blades and smite your foes from the sky.

Your Daybreak projectiles scorch targets on impact.

2274196887.name: Well of Radiance
2274196887.inGameDescription: Thrust your Sword into the ground, damaging and scorching nearby targets. The sword projects a continuous aura, granting radiant effects and restoration to nearby allies, protecting them from the effects of Stasis.

2275087323.name: Explosive Light
2275087323.inGameDescription: Picking up an Orb of Power increases the next projectile's blast radius and damage. Increases the stack count limit.

2276384431.name: Tactile String
2276384431.inGameDescription:
Stable, high-friction bowstring.
  •  Slightly increases accuracy
  •  Increases stability

2280583391.name: Fail-deadly
2280583391.inGameDescription: Dealing damage grants an improved stacking bonus to magazine size, target acquisition, and range until your next final blow with this weapon.

2282937672.name: Bipod
2282937672.inGameDescription: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

2284787283.name: Clown Cartridge
2284787283.inGameDescription: Reloading this weapon randomly overfills it from reserves.

2287699930.name: Broadhead
2287699930.inGameDescription: Piercing arrowhead that damages the target on entry and exit. One shot can overpenetrate multiple targets.

2289534249.name: Bewildering Burst
2289534249.inGameDescription: Reloading this weapon after defeating a target causes the next hit to launch a Kinetic projectile that detonates into a disorienting blast.

2292872001.name: Microcosm Catalyst
2292872001.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2295881363.name: Restoration Ritual
2295881363.inGameDescription: Reviving allies or defeating combatants with finishers reloads this weapon and readies an emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Handling is improved.

2298656195.name: Circle of Life
2298656195.inGameDescription: Rapidly healing allies grants this weapon a period of increased damage.

2299867342.name: Pocket Singularity
2299867342.inGameDescription:
Launch an unstable ball of Void energy that detonates when it nears a target, pushing them away from the blast and making them volatile.  

Provides multiple charges.

2302125028.name: Nano-Munitions
2302125028.inGameDescription: Being near allies slowly builds up an improved partial emergency ammo refill for the next time this weapon runs out of ammo. Emergency ammo amount increases with time spent near allies.

2305480722.name: Mega Kill Clip
2305480722.inGameDescription: Reloading after a final blow grants a period of increased damage. Additional final blows before reloading further increases the duration of the damage period.

2305599261.name: Precision Frame
2305599261.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2306441428.name: Supercharged Battery
2306441428.inGameDescription: Collecting an Orb of Power grants a period of maximum power that starts with an automatic reload. Sustained fire in this mode suppresses targets.

2307143135.name: Harsh Truths
2307143135.inGameDescription: This weapon fires a 5-round burst. When a nearby ally is killed, gain health regeneration and increased movement speed.

2307689415.name: Arcane Needle
2307689415.inGameDescription: Sling a woven needle that will embed in your target, unraveling them. Activate your melee ability again to chain up to two additional attacks.

2308090567.name: Field Prep
2308090567.inGameDescription: Greatly increases ammo generation. Improves reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

2316126473.name: High Priority
2316126473.inGameDescription: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Trace Rifle's magazine from reserves. Damaging a vehicle, boss, or Champion with a Trace Rifle marks them as the target. When an ally defeats the marked target, Special ammo is generated for you and Heavy ammo for your allies.

2319119708.name: High Ground
2319119708.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant stacks of bonus damage. Attacking targets from higher ground immediately grants the maximum number of stacks.

2319885414.name: Solar Weapon Surge
2319885414.inGameDescription: Collecting an Orb of Power causes you to gain 1 temporary Armor Charge.

2327629476.name: Forge's Kin
2327629476.inGameDescription: Black Armory weapon final blows briefly grant ammo generation, reload speed, and damage against combatants when the weapon is redrawn. Buff potency and duration increases for each equipped Black Armory weapon.

2331097520.name: Dynamic Heat Weapon
2331097520.inGameDescription: Higher base damage, increased damage versus powerful combatants. High heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Weapon cools down more rapidly between shots.

2333607307.name: Impetus
2333607307.inGameDescription: Reloading immediately after a kill increases weapon damage for a short time.

2338887882.name: Balanced Guard
2338887882.inGameDescription: Sword Guard has balanced overall defenses.

2341747657.name: Kismet
2341747657.inGameDescription:
After landing a final blow while at full health, or when out of combat for an extended duration, your shields will slowly recharge into an overshield. 

When you have an overshield, your weapons gain increased accuracy, stability, handling, and damage against combatants, and final blows will grant a short period of increased mobility once the overshield is depleted.

2349202967.name: Heavy Guard
2349202967.inGameDescription: Sword Guard has high overall defenses, but lowers charge rate.

2353477480.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2353477480.inGameDescription: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

2355041704.name: Solar Rampart
2355041704.inGameDescription: Solar final blows recharge your Barricade. While you have a Solar Super equipped, casting your Barricade unleashes waves of Solar energy that damage and scorch targets. Combatants damaged and Guardians defeated by these waves are enveloped in a Sunspot.

2359854504.name: Salvation's Grip Catalyst
2359854504.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2360347339.name: Impromptu Ammunition
2360347339.inGameDescription: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

2360754333.name: Trench Barrel
2360754333.inGameDescription: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, handling, and reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

2362217257.name: Leviathan's Breath Catalyst
2362217257.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat combatants while using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

Defeating high-tier Wrathborn with any weapon or ability will unlock this objective significantly faster.

2363751990.name: Infinite Guard
2363751990.inGameDescription: Sword Guard has balanced defenses and maximized endurance.

2364577709.name: Lightweight Emitter
2364577709.inGameDescription:
Weight reduction for better agility.
  •  Increases reload speed
  •  Slightly increases handling speed
  •  Decreases shield duration

2371713880.name: Barrel Shroud
2371713880.inGameDescription:
Balanced shotgun barrel.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Increases handling speed

2379536009.name: Remote Shield
2379536009.inGameDescription: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : When weapon is fully charged, consume charge before firing to make your next shot deploy a protective shield on impact. Passing through the protective shield provides a Void Overshield and improves weapon damage, reload speed, and handling.

2383960413.name: Cruel Remedy
2383960413.inGameDescription: Kills with this weapon heal the wielder. Precision kills also refill the magazine.

2385083333.name: Mag-lev Rail
2385083333.inGameDescription:
Magnetic levitation massively decreases friction, allowing higher bolt velocity.
  •  Greatly increases projectile speed
  •  Decreases persistence

2387244414.name: Zen Moment
2387244414.inGameDescription: Causing damage with this weapon reduces recoil and flinch over time.

2395713912.name: Umbral Sustenance
2395713912.inGameDescription: This weapon's magazine is automatically reloaded when you gain Devour, a Void overshield, or become invisible.

2396422520.name: Slideways
2396422520.inGameDescription: Sliding partially reloads this weapon's magazine and temporarily boosts handling and stability greatly.

2396489472.name: Chain Reaction
2396489472.inGameDescription: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

2398680997.name: Empowered Rail
2398680997.inGameDescription:
Imbuing a rail with paracausal energy improves the durability and effect duration of bolts.
  •  Greatly increases persistence
  •  Decreases handling speed

2399646028.name: Leviathan's Sigh
2399646028.inGameDescription: When fully drawn, the bolt creates a large concussive blast that knocks combatants back and makes them volatile.

2400634603.name: Thermite Grenade
2400634603.inGameDescription: A grenade that sends forth a burning line of fire, dealing damage and scorching targets in its path.

2402480669.name: Focused Fury
2402480669.inGameDescription: Dealing a portion of the magazine as precision damage grants this weapon bonus damage for an improved duration. The shot count is reset whenever the weapon is reloaded or stowed.

2405598968.name: Vestigial Alchemy
2405598968.inGameDescription:
This weapon gains energy when you pick up Vestiges and allows you to create ammo at the projectile impact point for you and your allies. Special ammo mode unlocks at 50% energy, while Heavy ammo mode unlocks at 100% energy. 

To transform Vestiges into Special ammo, [Alternate Weapon Action]  to activate Special ammo mode. [Alternate Weapon Action]  a second time to activate Heavy ammo mode.

2405638014.name: Red Dot Micro
2405638014.inGameDescription:
Agile sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases handling speed

2405638015.name: Red Dot 2 MOA
2405638015.inGameDescription:
Snapshot sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Slightly increases range
  •  Increases handling speed

2406549743.name: Concussion Grenades
2406549743.inGameDescription: Grenades fired from this weapon emit a blast that staggers enemies.

2407733996.name: Elliptical Orbit
2407733996.inGameDescription: After briefly sprinting, gain significantly increased ammo generation. Alternatively, gain significantly more stability, reload speed, and flinch resistance when not sprinting for a short duration.

2409031770.name: Wardcliff Coil Catalyst
2409031770.inGameDescription: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2409208302.name: Precision Frame
2409208302.inGameDescription: This weapon fires small auto-tracking rockets. Rockets lock onto targets when aimed.

2410284308.name: TrueSight IS
2410284308.inGameDescription:
Light, flexible sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases handling speed

2410284310.name: Fastdraw IS
2410284310.inGameDescription:
Lightweight sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Slightly increases range

2410284311.name: Quickdraw IS
2410284311.inGameDescription:
Agile sight. Short zoom.
  •  Greatly increases handling speed

2410819063.name: Pinpoint Slug Frame
2410819063.inGameDescription: Fires a single-slug round. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2414725840.name: Satou Focus Lens
2414725840.inGameDescription:
Far scope. Long zoom. Highlights enemy targets.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

2414725841.name: Satou Precision Lens
2414725841.inGameDescription:
Precision scope. Long zoom.
  •  Greatly increases range
  •  Decreases handling speed

2415292777.name: Crossing Over
2415292777.inGameDescription: This weapon has significantly increased range and handling for the top half of the magazine, while rounds from the bottom half of the magazine deal significantly increased damage.

2416023159.name: Offhand Strike
2416023159.inGameDescription: Final blows grant additional weapon range, stability, and accuracy when firing from the hip for a short duration.

2420895100.name: Extended Mag
2420895100.inGameDescription:
This weapon has a greatly increased magazine size, but reloads much slower.
  •  Greatly increases magazine size
  •  Greatly decreases reload speed
  •  Increases airborne effectiveness

2420924065.name: Bandolier
2420924065.inGameDescription: Grants slightly increased ammo generation and magazine size.

2422968039.name: Adrenaline Junkie
2422968039.inGameDescription: This weapon gains increased damage and handling from final blows with grenades or this weapon for an improved duration.

2426323900.name: Energized
2426323900.inGameDescription: This mod has been deprecated and no longer functions. You may replace it with another mod.

2426674025.name: Pinpoint Slug Frame
2426674025.inGameDescription: Fires a single-slug round. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2427219599.name: Spread Shot
2427219599.inGameDescription: Fires a short range spread of pellets.

2428997981.name: Permeability
2428997981.inGameDescription: Using your class ability changes this weapon's damage type to match your equipped Super until you stow the weapon.

2437618208.name: Tex Balanced Stock
2437618208.inGameDescription: Damaging targets while firing from the hip increases handling, reload speed, and movement speed while aiming down sights.

2440389870.name: Composite Propellant
2440389870.inGameDescription: Rockets embed themselves in struck targets and periodically eject incendiary fuel that inflicts Scorch. The longer this weapon goes without firing, the more fuel the next rocket contains. Strong against [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions.

2444870733.name: Heavy Burst
2444870733.inGameDescription: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

2445247031.name: Barri-nade
2445247031.inGameDescription: Using your class ability channels defensive Light inward, providing a grenade that creates a barricade on impact. Picking up Orbs of Power enhances your next Barri-nade, spawning more barricades on impact.

2450788523.name: Killing Wind
2450788523.inGameDescription: Final blows grant increased mobility, weapon range, and handling for a short duration.

2451262963.name: Fragile Focus
2451262963.inGameDescription: This weapon gains bonus range until your shield is destroyed. The bonus returns once your shield has regenerated to full strength.

2451540357.name: Amalgamation Rounds
2451540357.inGameDescription:
Aiming down sights for a short period without firing compresses the spread into a single high-density projectile. Damaging a target with this shot marks them.

This weapon deals additional damage to marked targets. Defeating a marked target or landing a precision final blow with an Amalgamation Round grants invisibility and truesight.

2458213969.name: Multikill Clip
2458213969.inGameDescription: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand.

2458294492.name: Precision Frame
2458294492.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2458610193.name: Light Touch
2458610193.inGameDescription: This weapon gains reload speed, handling, and aim down sight speed when you are amplified, radiant, or have Devour.

2459015849.name: Trench Barrel
2459015849.inGameDescription: After a successful melee hit, this weapon gains increased damage, improved handling, and improved reload speed for a short duration—or until three shots are fired.

2460489707.name: Cursed Thrall
2460489707.inGameDescription: After defeating a target with a melee attack, final blows with this weapon cause targets to explode for an improved duration.

2463983862.name: Silkstrike
2463983862.inGameDescription:
Weave a vicious rope dart and tear through your targets.

[Light Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in front of you to deal damage. The tip of the dart deals bonus damage, and defeating targets with the tip causes them to explode.

[Heavy Attack]  : Swing the rope dart in a circular motion to deal heavy damage all around you.

[Grenade]  : Use the grapple to move forward quickly.

2467967826.name: Chambered Compensator
2467967826.inGameDescription:
Stable barrel attachment.
  •  Increases stability
  •  Moderately controls recoil
  •  Slightly decreases handling speed

2470512752.name: Grapple
2470512752.inGameDescription:
Weave a grappling hook, and quickly pull yourself forward. Grappling to a Tangle immediately recharges your grenade energy.

During and shortly after grappling, your melee attack deals area damage and unravels targets.

2470575005.name: MIDA Synergy
2470575005.inGameDescription: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped. When MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped, this weapon grants additional speed benefits and final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.

2471523345.name: Glacial Fortification
2471523345.inGameDescription: While you have a Stasis Super equipped, your Barricade becomes a wall of Stasis crystals that slows nearby targets when created. Standing behind this barricade will grant you and your allies increased weapon reload speed, stability, and range.

2473404935.name: Mad Scientist
2473404935.inGameDescription: This weapon fires a volley of rockets and grants Bolt Charge to all nearby allies for every other rocket that it fires.

2476672792.name: Threat Remover
2476672792.inGameDescription: Dealing damage with nearly all pellets in a spread increases reload speed, handling, and stability.

2479787361.name: Rapid-Fire Glaive
2479787361.inGameDescription: Fast firing melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield. Generates shield energy on dealing ranged damage.

2481624867.name: Storm Grenade
2481624867.inGameDescription: A grenade that calls down a focused lightning storm.

2482418662.name: Longest Winter
2482418662.inGameDescription: Periodically generates Ionic Traces while in its high-damage state.

2485406866.name: Overshield
2485406866.inGameDescription: You are armored with a protective barrier of [Void] Void Light. Reduces damage taken from combatants.

2485411080.name: Psychohack
2485411080.inGameDescription:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

2489430594.name: Indomitability
2489430594.inGameDescription: Final blows grant grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

2490530085.name: Adaptive Frame
2490530085.inGameDescription: A well-rounded grip, reliable and sturdy.

2491817779.name: Prototype Trueseeker
2491817779.inGameDescription: This weapon's rockets have tracking. Lock onto targets when aiming down sights. Landing hits with a full magazine grants ammo and boosts the next magazine with increased tracking strength, stability, fire rate, and cluster bombs.

2491949917.name: Support Frame
2491949917.inGameDescription: Capable of healing allies and hurting targets. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Unraveling projectiles.

2493618392.name: Resurgence Directive III
2493618392.inGameDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

2493618393.name: Resurgence Directive II
2493618393.inGameDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

2493618399.name: Resurgence Directive IV
2493618399.inGameDescription: Light attacks generate Sword energy and have the chance to spawn seeking Quicksilver nanites that heal the wielder upon attaching.

2495011826.name: Ensemble
2495011826.inGameDescription: Substantially improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

2495523340.name: Towering Barricade
2495523340.inGameDescription: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2495523341.name: Rally Barricade
2495523341.inGameDescription: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2496039278.name: Bullwhacker
2496039278.inGameDescription: Aim down sights for a period of time to overcharge the next bolt fired. Increases damage and area of effect for each charge level.

2500502982.name: Firewalker
2500502982.inGameDescription: Increase the damage of Solar weapons and Solar Ignitions based on the amount of Roaring Flames stacks you have. You are harder to suspend, slow, or freeze, and when you break out, you take no damage from doing so, creating a burst of Solar energy around yourself.

2509860981.name: Nadir Focus
2509860981.inGameDescription: Sustained fire increases accuracy and range. Increases lunge distance for Swords, and projectile velocity for Launchers.

2516075140.name: High-Impact Frame
2516075140.inGameDescription: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

2516532331.name: Arc Conductor
2516532331.inGameDescription: When taking Arc Damage, this weapon becomes more powerful and resists incoming Arc Damage. Kills extend the time in this overcharged state.

2518716062.name: Aggressive Frame
2518716062.inGameDescription: High damage, moderate charge time. Fires a horizontal volley.

2519102437.name: Sever
2519102437.inGameDescription:
The target's connections to the world around them are cut, and their outgoing damage is significantly reduced.

Severed targets unwind into a Tangle when defeated.

2523469161.name: Classy Contender
2523469161.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant improved class ability energy.

2523856971.name: Explosive Bolts
2523856971.inGameDescription:
Bolts explode shortly after hitting the environment or a target, but deal less damage on impact.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

2526801077.name: Gjallarhorn Catalyst
2526801077.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2529412083.name: Blunt Execution Rounds
2529412083.inGameDescription: Damaging nearby combatants with melee abilities dramatically increases handling and damage. Expires after an improved short duration or the next shot.

2538516770.name: Tessellation Catalyst
2538516770.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2540536653.name: Ravenous Beast
2540536653.inGameDescription:
This weapon stores power when dealing or receiving damage; defeating combatants or dealing damage to Scorched combatants grants increased progress.
[Alternate Weapon Action]  : Unleashes the beast when full, increasing outgoing damage and reducing incoming Solar damage.

2541826827.name: Repulsor Brace
2541826827.inGameDescription: Defeating a Void-debuffed target grants an overshield that lasts for an improved duration.

2543177538.name: Penumbral Blast
2543177538.inGameDescription: Raise your [Stasis] Stasis staff against your foe. Send a blast of [Stasis] Stasis forward to freeze your targets.

2544048574.name: Indomitability
2544048574.inGameDescription: Final blows grant improved grenade energy when playing a Light subclass or improved melee energy when playing a Darkness subclass.

2551157718.name: Box Breathing
2551157718.inGameDescription: Aiming this weapon for a short period without firing grants bonus range and precision damage that resets after firing or exiting zoom.

2552577806.name: Serrated Bolts
2552577806.inGameDescription:
Recovering a bolt from a living target deals damage.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

2552875793.name: Aggressive Frame
2552875793.inGameDescription: High damage, high recoil. Optimized for long-distance shooting.

2557881346.name: Vortex Frame
2557881346.inGameDescription:
[Heavy Attack]  : Launch a heavy spin attack.
Heavy attacks are stronger with full energy.

2562668800.name: Collective Action
2562668800.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of further increased damage. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

2563509458.name: Precision Frame
2563509458.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2564164194.name: Compounding Force
2564164194.inGameDescription: Fires slugs that cause massive damage to combatant shields. Strong against [Shield-Piercing] Barrier Champions.

2565067140.name: Head Rush
2565067140.inGameDescription: Sliding or standing up after crouching for a short time grants this weapon a brief period of bonus handling, reload speed, and damage against Hive combatants.

2565885237.name: Nightsworn Sight
2565885237.inGameDescription:
Dealing final blows to targets grants Nightsworn Sight. 

During that time, final blows grant Truesight, reload speed and precision damage is increased, and submunitions weaken targets.

2570477205.name: Multikill Clip
2570477205.inGameDescription: Reloading grants increased damage based on the number of rapid final blows made beforehand for an improved duration.

2571259936.name: Compressed Wave Frame
2571259936.inGameDescription: Projectiles release a wave of compressed energy when they contact the ground.

2575933030.name: Atomizing Rounds
2575933030.inGameDescription: Rounds fired embed themselves in targets. [Alternate Weapon Action]  to detonate embedded rounds.

2576986935.name: Null Factor
2576986935.inGameDescription: Withering Blade hits and bounces create a small Stasis crystal and refund a portion of melee energy. Using Withering Blade to shatter crystals or frozen targets releases a spread of Withering Blades.

2578642829.name: Suppression
2578642829.inGameDescription:
The target is taken out of any active abilities and cannot activate any abilities or movement modes while suppression persists. Afflicted combatants cannot fire their weapons.

When suppressed, [Disruption] Overload Champions are stunned.

2578928832.name: Rewind Rounds
2578928832.inGameDescription: When this weapon's magazine is empty, it refills from reserves based on the number of hits.

2578928833.name: Headseeker
2578928833.inGameDescription: Body shots landed with this weapon increase precision damage and aim assist for a short time. Body shots landed while the perk is active refresh the time.

2578928835.name: Rapid Hit
2578928835.inGameDescription: Rapid precision hits temporarily increase stability and reload speed.

2579169598.name: Lone Wolf
2579169598.inGameDescription: Slightly improves aim assist, aim down sights speed, and airborne effectiveness. Increases these effects when there are no nearby allies.

2581086849.name: Incendiary Grenade
2581086849.inGameDescription: A grenade that explodes in a fiery burst and heavily scorches nearby targets.

2581144697.name: Sharp Harvest
2581144697.inGameDescription: Landing three light-attack hits within an improved short time grants special ammo.

2585427437.name: Traitor's Vessel
2585427437.inGameDescription:
Fires a wide horizontal spread when shot from the hip.
Final blows with this weapon have a chance to generate Ionic Traces. Powerful foes and opposing Guardians always generate Ionic Traces.

2586829431.name: Shot Swap
2586829431.inGameDescription: Final blows build and store charges which allow you to swap and stow this weapon at a faster rate.

2589105944.name: Taken Repurposing
2589105944.inGameDescription: This mod's perks are only active in the "Last Wish" raid.

2589407652.name: Timelost Magazine
2589407652.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus Super energy. When your Super expires, this weapon's magazine size is doubled for a long duration and reloads from reserves.

2590710093.name: Tireless Blade
2590710093.inGameDescription: Sword ammo granted for every other powered sword kill.

2594592626.name: Controlled Burst
2594592626.inGameDescription: Landing every shot in a burst grants this weapon increased damage and reduced charge time for a short duration.

2597494435.name: Frame of Reference
2597494435.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.

2600715579.name: Harmonic Resonance
2600715579.inGameDescription: Equipping multiple weapons from this set grants this weapon improved reload speed and handling. It also deals increased damage versus targets wielding Light and Darkness.

2607392828.name: Heart Piercer
2607392828.inGameDescription: Rounds from this weapon shatter into submunitions on impact. Strong against [Disruption] Overload Champions.

2608508147.name: Heavy Slug Thrower
2608508147.inGameDescription: [Aim Down Sights]  : Spins up this weapon. This weapon can be fired only when fully spun up.

2610012052.name: Golden Tricorn
2610012052.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

2613226185.name: Collective Demolition
2613226185.inGameDescription:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

2617324347.name: High-Impact Frame
2617324347.inGameDescription: Slow firing and high damage. This weapon is more accurate when stationary, moving slowly, and aiming down sights.

2617553311.name: Rimestealer
2617553311.inGameDescription: Destroying a Stasis crystal or defeating a frozen target with this weapon grants you an improved amount of Frost Armor.

2618534366.name: Absorption Cells
2618534366.inGameDescription: Final blows or sustained damage with weapons matching your equipped Super damage type grant you Super energy. When your Super energy is full, you instead gain a temporary bonus to weapon damage of that type. When you've exhausted your Super, matching elemental weapons' damage temporarily causes explosions around the target.

2620589274.name: The Fundamentals
2620589274.inGameDescription: [Alternate Weapon Action]  : Changes this weapon's damage type, cycling between Void, Arc, and Solar. Grants this weapon temporarily increased damage when you apply or gain an elemental buff or debuff that matches this weapon's damage type.

2621346526.name: Ensemble
2621346526.inGameDescription: Improved handling and reload speed when allies are nearby.

2622129339.name: Support Frame
2622129339.inGameDescription: Capable of healing allies and hurting foes. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and bestows restoration to your allies.

2625980631.name: Silence and Squall
2625980631.inGameDescription:
Summon two Stasis kamas, Silence and Squall, that you throw one after another.

Silence : Creates a flash-freeze blast that freezes and damages targets.

Squall : Creates a Stasis Storm that slows and damages targets caught inside.

2628485816.name: Strafe Glide
2628485816.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with strong directional control.

2628485817.name: Burst Glide
2628485817.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with a strong initial boost of speed.

2628485818.name: Balanced Glide
2628485818.inGameDescription: Jump while airborne to activate Glide and start an airborne drift with both moderate speed and directional control.

2633604463.name: Rolling Storm
2633604463.inGameDescription:
Final blows grant Bolt Charge.
While amplified, final blows grant additional Bolt Charge. 
Gain increased Bolt Charge stacks when you have none.

2635532173.name: Accurized Rounds
2635532173.inGameDescription:
This weapon can fire longer distances.
  •  Increases range

2636679416.name: Hail Barrage
2636679416.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant Stasis arrows. Your next hip-fire shot will fire all of them in a single volley.

2637025676.name: The Whispers
2637025676.inGameDescription: Gain an additional melee charge. Powered melee final blows spawn an Orb of Power.

2641107734.name: Unrepentant
2641107734.inGameDescription: Reloading after defeating a target causes the next burst to be a longer, more powerful superburst.

2649013855.name: Full Auto Trigger System
2649013855.inGameDescription: Holding down the trigger will fire this weapon at full auto. Improves reload.

2652708987.name: Successful Warm-Up
2652708987.inGameDescription: Each final blow increases charge/draw speed.

2653210971.name: Land Tank
2653210971.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon grant increased health and improved damage resistance from combatants.

2655147888.name: Snareweaver IV
2655147888.inGameDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

2655147894.name: Snareweaver II
2655147894.inGameDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

2655147895.name: Snareweaver III
2655147895.inGameDescription: Precision hits and final blows build energy towards a Snareweaver arrow that can be fired from the hip. On impact, Snareweaver arrows create a pattern of traps that suspend nearby targets.

2656694271.name: Swooping Talons
2656694271.inGameDescription: Dealing damage while airborne increases this weapon's damage output.

2657901002.name: Threaded Spike
2657901002.inGameDescription: Throw a rope dart that bounces between targets, damaging and severing them. The dart will return to you once it's done, returning melee energy to you for each target hit. Press [Melee] just as the dart gets back to you to catch it and increase the amount of energy returned.

2657901004.name: Knife Trick
2657901004.inGameDescription: Throw a fan of flaming knives that scorch targets on hit.

2657901005.name: Combination Blow
2657901005.inGameDescription:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.

2657901006.name: Withering Blade
2657901006.inGameDescription:
Toss a [Stasis] Stasis Shuriken at targets to damage and slow them.  

Provides multiple charges.

2657901007.name: Snare Bomb
2657901007.inGameDescription:
Throw a Smoke Bomb that attaches to surfaces and pings enemy radar, then detonates into a disorienting smoke cloud, weakening nearby targets. Targets within the smoke cloud take damage over time.

Upon deployment, makes nearby allies invisible.

2658083589.name: Surplus
2658083589.inGameDescription: Substantially increases handling, reload speed, and stability for each fully charged ability.

2662236651.name: Archer's Gambit
2662236651.inGameDescription: Hipfire precision hits grant a massive draw speed bonus for an improved duration. Further precision hits extend the duration.

2662827496.name: Aggressive Frame
2662827496.inGameDescription: Hard-hitting, high recoil. Increases rate of fire after final blows.

2663272109.name: Relentless Tracker
2663272109.inGameDescription: Damaging a powerful combatant or Guardian with an ability temporarily increases weapon damage of the same type. Defeating that marked target with damage that matches the element creates an Elemental pickup.

2663272110.name: Hawkeye Hack
2663272110.inGameDescription: Precision final blows reduce the cooldown of your Super. Modifies Golden Gun to fire a single, high-damage shot. Targets defeated by that shot give you Super energy and explode.

2663272111.name: Upgraded Sensor Pack
2663272111.inGameDescription: Provides radar while you're aiming. Enhances your radar resolution while crouched. Visually marks targets. Deals more damage to low-health marked targets. Provides a small benefit to the airborne effectiveness stat of all weapons.

2670025099.name: MIDA Synergy
2670025099.inGameDescription: Superb handling. Move faster with this weapon equipped. When MIDA Multi-Tool is equipped, this weapon grants additional speed benefits and final blows grant modification progress to MIDA Multi-Tool.

2671305723.name: Accelerated Assault
2671305723.inGameDescription: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon loads slightly more ammo from reserves, or removes more heat, and increases damage.

2674202880.name: Worldline Catalyst
2674202880.inGameDescription: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2675184851.name: Incandescent
2675184851.inGameDescription:
Defeating a target spreads a longer lasting scorch to those nearby.
More powerful combatants and opposing Guardians cause scorch in a larger radius.

2675361166.name: Wellspring
2675361166.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of ability energy. This energy is divided between your uncharged abilities.

2679249093.name: One-Two Punch
2679249093.inGameDescription: Hitting an enemy with every pellet in a shot increases melee damage for a short duration.

2679722414.name: Suspend
2679722414.inGameDescription:
The target is immobilized by a web of [Strand] Strand matter, lifting them into the air. While suspended, Guardians are unable to move freely, combatants are unable to move or fire their weapon, and [Stagger] Unstoppable Champions are stunned.

Suspended targets unwind into a Tangle when defeated.

2680121939.name: Enhanced Battery
2680121939.inGameDescription:
Strong battery life.
  •  Increases magazine size

2682205016.name: Overflow
2682205016.inGameDescription: Picking up Special or Heavy ammo loads this weapon even further beyond normal capacity.

2689511581.name: Verglas Curve Catalyst
2689511581.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2691822036.name: Contending Cascade
2691822036.inGameDescription: This weapon gains bonus handling and reload speed based on your longest chain of rapid final blows from any source. After achieving a less impressive record, final blows with this weapon create an elemental damage explosion.

2696719570.name: Adaptive Glaive
2696719570.inGameDescription: Balances melee/ranged polearm with a frontal shield. Generates shield energy after dealing ranged damage.

2697390518.name: Accelerated Assault
2697390518.inGameDescription: Dealing sustained damage with this weapon increases reload speed and Sword charge rate and slightly increases damage.

2703413509.name: Psychohack
2703413509.inGameDescription:
Sustained damage from this weapon exhausts the target for an improved duration.

Exhausted targets deal reduced outgoing damage.

2707250581.name: Support Frame
2707250581.inGameDescription: Capable of healing allies and hurting targets. Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and spawns Unraveling projectiles.

2708585276.name: Ballistic Slam
2708585276.inGameDescription:
After sprinting and while airborne, activate your charged melee ability to slam to the ground, dealing damage to nearby targets.

Gain Super energy and stacks of Bolt Charge based on number of targets hit by Ballistic Slam.

2708585277.name: Seismic Strike
2708585277.inGameDescription:
After sprinting for a short time, activate your charged melee ability to slam shoulder-first into your target, damaging and blinding targets in an area around them.

While you are amplified, the blind radius is increased.

2708585279.name: Thunderclap
2708585279.inGameDescription:
[Melee] : Hold while grounded to plant your feet and begin charging your fist with Arc energy.

[Melee] : Release to unleash a devastating blast in front of you, dealing damage that increases with longer charge time.

2710254013.name: The Lost Voice
2710254013.inGameDescription: Healing grenades spawn a Restorative Turret. Healing allies occasionally spawns an Orb of Power.

2710582428.name: Heretical Behavior
2710582428.inGameDescription: Sustained weapon damage or final blows versus powerful targets grant this weapon bonus reload, handling, and damage versus combatants for an improved duration. Gain this bonus immediately for a significantly longer duration when you are revived.

2711519340.name: Gambler's Dodge
2711519340.inGameDescription: Dodge to perform a deft tumble, avoiding combatant attacks and generating melee ability energy. Energy gain is scaled by your Melee stat. Dodging near enemies increases the energy gain.

2711519341.name: Marksman's Dodge
2711519341.inGameDescription: Dodge to perform an evasive maneuver with a steady hand. Dodging automatically collects nearby ammo boxes and reloads all weapons.

2711519343.name: Acrobat's Dodge
2711519343.inGameDescription: Dodge to perform an acrobatic leap. Upon landing, make yourself and nearby allies radiant.

2713325501.name: Light Buffs
2713325501.inGameDescription: Light buffs include [Arc] Amplified, [Arc] Bolt Charge, [Solar] Cure, [Solar] Radiant, [Solar] Restoration, [Void] Devour, [Void] Invisibility, and [Void] Overshield.

2713678205.name: Low-Impedance Windings
2713678205.inGameDescription:
Improved output efficiency.
  •  Increases shield duration
  •  Slightly increases reload speed
  •  Decreases range

2716335210.name: Disorienting Blow
2716335210.inGameDescription: Striking a target with this melee ability blinds them, amplifies you, and grants you a moderate amount of Bolt Charge.

2716335211.name: Combination Blow
2716335211.inGameDescription:
A quick strike that temporarily increases your melee damage when defeating a target, stacking three times.

Defeating targets with this, grants class ability energy and restores a small amount of health. Energy gain is scaled by your Class stat.

2717805783.name: Moving Target
2717805783.inGameDescription: Increased movement speed and improved target acquisition when moving while aiming down sights.

2719770986.name: Auxiliary Reserves
2719770986.inGameDescription:
Additional energy storage.
  •  Greatly increases shield duration
  •  Decreases reload speed

2720533289.name: Magnificent Howl
2720533289.inGameDescription: The number of precision final blows before reloading affects the total rounds granted with increased range and damage. Precision final blows with Magnificent Howl active extend the effect for additional rounds.

2722573681.name: Shadowshot: Moebius Quiver
2722573681.inGameDescription:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

Fire two volleys of three Void Arrows that seek nearby targets. Shadowshot makes targets volatile and deals increased damage to tethered targets. Defeating tethered targets creates Orbs of Power.

While the Super is active, dealing damage increases the damage of your Void Arrows and Bow weapons.

2722573682.name: Spectral Blades
2722573682.inGameDescription:
Summon a pair of deadly Void blades and stalk the battlefield in a veil of shadows.

[Light Attack]  : Perform a quick melee attack.

[Heavy Attack]  : Perform a heavy attack that weakens your target, and once again vanish from sight.

2722573683.name: Shadowshot: Deadfall
2722573683.inGameDescription:
Tether foes to a Void Anchor, dramatically weakening and suppressing them for you and your allies.

The Void Anchors fired from Shadowshot pull targets toward the impact point, which then become traps and wait for prey. Void Anchors have increased range and last longer.

2722641740.name: Towering Barricade
2722641740.inGameDescription: Creates a large barrier that can be used to reinforce a position with cover, and draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2722641741.name: Rally Barricade
2722641741.inGameDescription: Creates a small barrier that you can peek over while aiming down sights; increases weapon reload speed, stability, and range. Draws hostile fire when you stand behind it.

2724693746.name: Touch of Malice
2724693746.inGameDescription: The final round in the magazine deals bonus damage, drawing from the wielder's life force, and then regenerates itself. Defeating powerful combatants or multiple targets rapidly restores health.

2724747993.name: Threadling
2724747993.inGameDescription: A creature woven from pure Strand matter that seeks nearby targets and attacks, dealing damage.

2725422375.name: Precision Frame
