2725422375.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2725575870.name: Anti-Oracle
2725575870.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Vault of Glass" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2725575871.name: Anti-Praetorian
2725575871.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Vault of Glass" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2726471870.name: Thresh
2726471870.inGameDescription: Killing combatants with this weapon generates a small amount of Super energy.

2727957645.name: High Octane
2727957645.inGameDescription: Igniting nearby targets partially replenishes fuel. This weapon refills itself from reserves upon gaining maximum fuel.

2731901709.name: Warlord's Sigil
2731901709.inGameDescription: Melee and finisher final blows increase melee damage. With maximum stacks, you gain vastly increased melee regeneration speed for a short time.

2731901710.name: Vampire's Caress
2731901710.inGameDescription: Melee and finisher final blows instantly grant cure and provide restoration for a short duration.

2731901711.name: Helium Spirals
2731901711.inGameDescription: Increases the duration of Solar Grenades. Solar melee kills grant unlimited Solar Grenade energy for a brief time.

2732252706.name: Devil's Ruin Catalyst
2732252706.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2732340361.name: Compact Arrow Shaft
2732340361.inGameDescription:
Thinner arrows to increase nocking speed and weapon handling.
  •  Increases handling speed 
  •  Increases reload speed

2732540911.name: Heavy Burst
2732540911.inGameDescription: Fires a hard-hitting, two-round burst. Slightly reduces flinching from incoming fire while aiming.

2732814938.name: Whisper Catalyst
2732814938.inGameDescription: When upgraded to a Masterwork, this weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

2732913576.name: Red Dot-OAS
2732913576.inGameDescription:
Accurized sight. Medium zoom.
  •  Increases range
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

2732913578.name: Red Dot-ORS
2732913578.inGameDescription:
Snapshot sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Slightly increases range
  •  Increases handling speed

2732913579.name: Red Dot-ORS1
2732913579.inGameDescription:
Agile sight. Short zoom. 
  •  Increases range
  •  Increases handling speed

2732952950.name: Balanced Heat Weapon
2732952950.inGameDescription: Very low heat generated. [Reload]  to vent heat from the weapon. Overheating forces a sustained vent. Manually venting at very high heat greatly increases venting speed.

2733244971.name: Trinary Vision
2733244971.inGameDescription: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a fan of three energy waves on contact with the ground.

2741975068.name: Slug Rifle
2741975068.inGameDescription: This weapon lobs explosive slugs. When you're aiming down sights, the slugs travel fast and straight. When you're firing from the hip, the explosion is larger and applies Scorch to the target.

2743098132.name: Precision Frame
2743098132.inGameDescription: Fires a long-range precision energy bolt. This weapon's recoil pattern is more predictably vertical.

2747500760.name: Burning Maul
2747500760.inGameDescription:
Summon a flaming maul and crush targets with the force of an earthquake.

[Light Attack]  : Spin the maul in a circle around you, damaging nearby targets.

[Heavy Attack]  : Slam the maul to the ground and create a cyclone of flames that seeks targets, dealing damage and scorching them.

2747500761.name: Hammer of Sol
2747500761.inGameDescription:
Summon a flaming hammer and wreak destruction down upon your enemies.

[Light Attack]  : Throw your hammer at foes.

Upon impact, your hammers shatter into explosive molten shards.

2748258257.name: Heating Up
2748258257.inGameDescription: Final blows with this weapon increase accuracy and stability while improving vertical recoil for a longer duration.

2748801589.name: Harmony
2748801589.inGameDescription: Final blows with other weapons improve this weapon's damage and performance for an improved duration.

2749775325.name: Light Battery
2749775325.inGameDescription:
Lightweight, agile battery.
  •  Increases handling speed
  •  Increases reload speed

2751656639.name: M1R Distribution Matrix
2751656639.inGameDescription: Fires a spread. Equipped with a quick-draining shield. Blocking damage with your shield gradually bestows Void overshields to yourself and nearby allies.

2757685314.name: Aggressive Frame
2757685314.inGameDescription: High damage, high recoil. Optimized for long-distance shooting.

2767894946.name: Paracausal Beam
2767894946.inGameDescription: Fires a beam of Kinetic light, dealing massive bonus damage to shields.

2769013282.name: Property: Undecidable
2769013282.inGameDescription: This [weapon|instrument|topology] adapts its damage type to match your equipped grenade. Final blows grant grenade and Transcendence energy.

2770223582.name: Fan Fire
2770223582.inGameDescription: This weapon fires full auto. Hip-fire shots deal bonus precision damage while increasing reload speed and accuracy.

2777563320.name: Liquid Coils
2777563320.inGameDescription:
Slower-building charge for higher damage.
  •  Increases impact damage
  •  Slower charge time

2778559527.name: Locked Armor Mod
2778559527.inGameDescription: This mod will become available for use when the requirements for unlocking it are met.

2779035018.name: Feeding Frenzy
2779035018.inGameDescription: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

2779468392.name: Siphoned Glyphkeeper
2779468392.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Vow of the Disciple" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2782457288.name: Killing Tally
2782457288.inGameDescription: Kills increase this weapon's damage until it is stowed or reloaded.

2783367502.name: Charged Bolts
2783367502.inGameDescription:
Bolts attached to targets deal damage over time.
[###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_button###][###DestinyNamedSubstitutions.ui_player_action_interact_verb###] with the bolt to retrieve it.

2785334058.name: Eddy Current
2785334058.inGameDescription: Temporarily increases reload speed and handling after sprinting or while amplified; increased reload speed and handling have a longer duration. This effect is significantly improved when you are amplified.

2795311559.name: Pace Yourself
2795311559.inGameDescription: Tapping the trigger gives this weapon less recoil and improves accuracy.

2797384170.name: The Manticore Catalyst
2797384170.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2799030358.name: Desperate Measures
2799030358.inGameDescription: Weapon final blows grant bonus damage for an improved duration. Melee and grenade final blows grant a larger damage bonus that can stack.

2799418574.name: Rites of Ember
2799418574.inGameDescription: Your Daybreak projectiles ignite targets on impact. Your Scorch deals additional damage, and builds to more powerful Ignitions. Dealing damage with Scorch or Ignitions grants melee energy.

2799667909.name: Silkbound Slayer
2799667909.inGameDescription: This weapon deals bonus damage to suspended targets. Gain faster draw time for a short duration when you suspend a target from any source or damage a suspended target with this weapon.

2799967529.name: Support Frame
2799967529.inGameDescription: Harming targets builds a restorative charge. Hip firing at allies while this weapon is charged heals them. Rapid healing increases weapon damage and grants Frost Armor to your allies.

2800865663.name: Swarmers
2800865663.inGameDescription: Destroying a Tangle spawns a Threadling. Your Threadlings unravel targets that they damage.

2801223209.name: Elastic String
2801223209.inGameDescription:
Excellent snapback.
  •  Decreases accuracy
  •  Faster draw time
  •  Slightly increases handling speed

2804214704.name: Umbral Sharpening
2804214704.inGameDescription:
This mod's perks are only active in the "Vow of the Disciple" raid.

Multiple copies of this mod stack and improve its effects.

2805134531.name: Nightmare Fuel
2805134531.inGameDescription: Powered melee and finisher final blows grant Nightmare Fuel, increasing handling and airborne effectiveness. While active, freshly drawn weapons deal additional damage and grant Nightmare Fuel on final blows. Gaining Nightmare Fuel reloads all holstered weapons.

2806361224.name: Rapid-Fire Frame
2806361224.inGameDescription: Deeper ammo reserves. Slightly faster reload when magazine is empty.

2809141585.name: Void Wall
2809141585.inGameDescription: A grenade that creates a horizontal wall of burning Void Light.

2809342386.name: Shackle Grenade
2809342386.inGameDescription: A thrown weapon of weighted Strand matter that detonates on impact, suspending targets and creating additional suspending subprojectiles.

2813913866.name: Demoralize
2813913866.inGameDescription: Precision final blows cause nearby targets to become weakened. Cooldown between activations reduced.

2814973067.name: Markov Chain
2814973067.inGameDescription: This weapon gains increased damage from melee kills and kills with this weapon. Melee kills grant ammo for this weapon.

2816578262.name: Monte Carlo Catalyst
2816578262.inGameDescription:
Upgrades this weapon to a Masterwork. Once upgraded, the weapon will obtain enhanced capabilities, such as increased stats and/or additional perks.

Defeat targets using this weapon to unlock this upgrade.

2816982784.name: Marksman's Dodge

[Light Attack]  : Attack.
[Block]  : Block.
[Grenade]  : Perform a Shield Throw.

Guard with Sentinel Shield to create a defensive wall that draws hostile fire. Allies behind the shield have increased survivability, weapon damage, and passive reload.

Guarding allies and blocking damage makes the shield last longer and increases your Shield Throw damage.

4260353953.name: Ward of Dawn

Create a protective dome for you and your allies.

While inside Ward of Dawn, allies gain Void overshield and increased weapon damage, while targets inside the Ward are weakened.

The Ward's owner also gains increased melee damage while inside and can pick up and throw the Ward's core to reposition the Ward up to two times.

4260353955.name: Twilight Arsenal
4260353955.inGameDescription:
[Super]  : Summon three Void axes and throw them at your foes one after another. On impact, the axes pull in nearby targets and detonate in a weakening explosion. After exploding, the axes can be picked up by you or your allies and used as a weapon for a short time.

While carrying a Void axe:
[Light Attack]  : Slash forward with your axe, dealing damage and weakening targets.
[Heavy Attack]  : Throw the axe, consuming all remaining ammo.
